summary: Get all line items for a specific purchase order
description:
Returns a paginated list of line items for the specified purchase order.
Supports Normal (default), Receiving, and Id view types.
The Receiving view returns receipt-specific details for each line item.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Purchase order ID

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Response view type

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: The page size between 1 and 100. For Ids view the maximum page size is 5000.

parameters.name: filters[estimated_delivery_at]
parameters.description: The date range string for estimated delivery dates. Format: [YYYY-MM-DD...YYYY-MM-DD] (e.g. [2026-01-01...2026-12-31])

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of purchase order line item IDs to filter by

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description: The updated date range string for purchase order line item modification dates. Format: [YYYY-MM-DD...YYYY-MM-DD] (e.g. [2026-01-01...2026-12-31])

parameters.name: filters[created_at]
parameters.description: The created date range string for purchase order line item creation dates. Format: [YYYY-MM-DD...YYYY-MM-DD] (e.g. [2026-01-01...2026-12-31])

parameters.name: filters[material_property_key]
parameters.description: The material property key for filtering line items

parameters.name: filters[material_property_value]
parameters.description: The material property value for filtering line items
